pageTitle: Delaware Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: What games are available at the Delaware state lottery?
items.answer:
Delaware State Lottery offers the following classic games:

 

Play 3® is a game where you select three digits and a bet type. Then you wait for the draw.

Play 4® is similar to Play 3®, but you choose four instead of three digits.

Delaware Lottery Powerball® is part of a Multi-State draw game system. Here you are up against the luring $40 million jackpot!

Delaware Lottery Mega Millions® gives you the chance to win the jackpot and the accompanying prizes from $2 to $1 million!

Delaware Lottery Lucky For Life® is an all-favorite game because it's the most fun! The top prize for this game is $1,000 for each day for life! Other cash prizes are also available.

Lotto America® is a multi-state lottery. Its jackpot and eight set cash prizes are guaranteed to blow everybody's minds.

Multi-win Lotto is a game where even not matching gives you a win!

Instant Games are everybody's favorites. All you have to do is choose your favorite ticket and scratch away.

Other games include Sports Lottery, Video Lottery, iGaming, Table Games, and Keno.

items.question: Can I remain anonymous if I win a big prize?
items.answer: Yes. Delaware Lottery winners can stay anonymous.

items.question: How do I claim my prize?
items.answer:
You can check Delaware Lottery results on the website, in the newspaper, or via a call. Delaware Lottery winning numbers get updated every time the draw is held, so you'll always find the latest winning numbers.

 

Depending on the amount you won, you can claim the prize in one of the following three places:

 

Delaware Lottery authorized retailer

Delaware Lottery Office

Delaware Lottery Redemption Center

If your winnings are less than $599, mailing the signed ticket to the Delaware Lottery Office will also work. For winnings over $5,000, you're going to need a government-issued ID and a Social Security Card.

items.question: Are my winnings taxed in Delaware?
items.answer:
Yes, your prize money is subject to the following taxes:

 

Delaware Income tax

Federal Income tax

Delaware Lottery will also retain 24% of the winnings when the prize amount is higher than $5,000.

items.question: How old should I be to buy a ticket?
items.answer: The legal age for buying lottery tickets in Delaware is 18 years old.

items.question: Where can I download the Delaware Lottery app?
items.answer: While the lottery website advertises the mobile app in the FAQ section, the link doesn't work. Plus, we failed to find an official Delaware Lottery app either on the App Store or on Google Play. However, the delottery.com works quite well on mobile browsers.

items.question: Who won the biggest Delaware lottery in 2020 so far?
items.answer: Who needs Delaware Lottery Second Chance, when you can win $150,000 during the first! An anonymous person collected their $150,000 Fortune Instant Game win on March 18, 2020.

items.question: Does the Delaware lottery offer any promotions or coupons?
items.answer: You won't currently find any Delaware Lottery codes on the internet. Still, the promo page includes several event promotions you can get from the lottery retailers.

items.question: How to win the Delaware lottery?
items.answer:
Delaware Lottery numbers get selected randomly and depend on the game you're playing.

 

The winning odds are highly dependent on the game and bidding type you choose.

items.question: Can I get the prize if I lose my ticket?
items.answer: The results of the Delaware Lottery game should always have proof. Keep your ticket safe until you claim your prize.
